candidates.source_name: Register účtovných závierok (RÚZ) — public portal
candidates.why_relevant: Statutory central register (Ministry of Finance / DataCentrum) where every Slovak accounting entity — including banks, branches of foreign banks, payment institutions, e-money institutions, leasing and fintech s.r.o. — must file individual and consolidated financial statements, notes, annual reports and auditor reports. Only reliable channel for actors that publish nothing voluntarily.
candidates.access_status: open, free, no login for public part
candidates.legal_status: public register under Act 431/2002 Z.z. on accounting; public part explicitly open
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Use the Open API (see separate entry) rather than HTML scraping; resolve entity by IČO, pull uctovne-zavierky + vyrocne-spravy, download PDF/XML attachments.
candidates.discovered_via_method: seed query + snowball from search results
queries_used: register účtovných závierok banka účtovná závierka 2025 registeruz.sk

candidates.source_name: RÚZ Open API (v2.5) — machine-readable filings feed
candidates.why_relevant: Documented JSON REST API over the whole register: /api/uctovne-jednotky, /api/uctovne-zavierky, /api/uctovne-vykazy, /api/vyrocne-spravy plus detail and codebook endpoints (pravne-formy, sk-nace). Supports incremental pulls via zmenene-od, so a scheduled collector can detect new bank/PSP filings the day they land. Documentation states CC0 licensing.
candidates.legal_status: published as open data, CC0 per API docs
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Nightly incremental job: GET /api/uctovne-zavierky?zmenene-od=YYYY-MM-DD, filter by SK NACE 64/65/66 and by an IČO watchlist of NBS-supervised entities; store XML/JSON statements + PDF annual reports.
candidates.discovered_via_method: snowball from RÚZ portal + open-data search
queries_used: registeruz.sk API otvorené dáta účtovné závierky data.gov.sk

candidates.source_name: Obchodný register SR (ORSR) — company search
candidates.why_relevant: Authoritative company register (Ministry of Justice / registry courts): legal form, registered capital, statutory bodies, shareholders, branches of foreign banks, historical changes. Baseline identity resolution (IČO, spisová značka) for every bank, PSP and fintech in scope; also the entry to the Zbierka listín.
candidates.access_status: free web search; extracts are informative-only, certified extracts are paid
candidates.legal_status: public register (Act 530/2003 Z.z.); free extract has informational character only
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Legacy ASP pages with stable query params (ID/SID/lan); light polite scraping keyed by IČO, or prefer RPO/Slovensko.Digital mirrors for bulk.
queries_used: obchodný register zbierka listín platobná inštitúcia orsr.sk

candidates.source_name: Zbierka listín Obchodného registra (ORSR document collection)
candidates.why_relevant: Statutory document collection: founding deeds, articles of association and their amendments, minutes on capital increases, mergers/cross-border mergers, auditor appointments, and historically financial statements. For non-listed banks, PSPs and fintechs this is often the only place where ownership restructurings and capital injections are documented.
candidates.access_status: list of filed documents visible free; obtaining copies via e-service, court fee may apply
candidates.legal_status: public; right to inspect and take copies after payment of a court fee
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Harvest the document LIST per entity (zbl.asp?ID=...) as an event feed of corporate actions; request individual listiny via sluzby.orsr.sk only for high-value targets.
queries_used: obchodný register zbierka listín platobná inštitúcia orsr.sk

candidates.source_name: Elektronické služby Obchodného registra (sluzby.orsr.sk)
candidates.why_relevant: New MS SR portal for e-services of the commercial register: request a document from the zbierka listín, file registrations/changes. Practical retrieval channel for the documents indexed on orsr.sk, and a signal source for pending corporate changes.
candidates.access_status: portal open; some services require eID/qualified electronic signature via slovensko.sk
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Manual/assisted retrieval for named targets; not suitable for bulk automation because of eID gating.
queries_used: obchodný register zbierka listín platobná inštitúcia orsr.sk

candidates.source_name: Obchodný vestník (Commercial Bulletin, MS SR)
candidates.why_relevant: Official electronic gazette. Audited entities publish balance-sheet and P&L data here; it also carries mergers, liquidations, insolvency/restructuring notices, general-meeting convocations and mandatory contract publications. High-frequency event feed complementing the annual RÚZ cadence.
candidates.access_status: electronic, publicly readable; publishing costs a fee (~EUR 99.50 for financial statements)
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Daily issue-level crawl with keyword/IČO filters over the financial-sector watchlist; parse the 'Konkurzy a reštrukturalizácie' and 'Účtovné závierky' sections.
queries_used: Obchodný vestník justice.gov.sk účtovné závierky zverejnenie banka

candidates.source_name: Register partnerov verejného sektora (RPVS) — rpvs.gov.sk
candidates.why_relevant: Any bank, PSP or IT/payments vendor receiving public money above thresholds must be registered with verified beneficial owners (konečný užívateľ výhod) and a verification document (verifikačný dokument) drafted by an oprávnená osoba. Reveals ownership chains and public-sector exposure that no annual report discloses.
candidates.legal_status: public register under Act 315/2016 Z.z.; Ministry of Justice, registry court Žilina
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Use the MS SR RPVS open-data REST API / OpenAPI for automated pulls; download verifikačné dokumenty (PDF) for entities on the payments watchlist.
queries_used: register partnerov verejného sektora RPVS rpvs.gov.sk konečný užívateľ výhod banka

candidates.source_name: RPVS Open Data / REST API (Ministerstvo spravodlivosti SR)
candidates.why_relevant: Automated REST access to RPVS records — partners, beneficial owners, authorised persons — enabling systematic ownership-graph building across Slovak payments actors instead of one-off lookups.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scheduled REST pull of changed records; join on IČO with RÚZ and ORSR.

candidates.source_name: Ministerstvo spravodlivosti SR — registre / otvorené dáta hub
candidates.why_relevant: Central pointer to MS SR register APIs (OpenAPI/Swagger UI at obcan.justice.sk) and to a contact channel (servicedesk.mssr@justice.sk) for extended datasets or bulk integration — the route to negotiated access if public endpoints are insufficient.

candidates.source_name: Register právnických osôb, podnikateľov a orgánov verejnej moci (RPO) — REST API
candidates.why_relevant: Consolidated identity register (Štatistický úrad SR / MV SR) merging commercial register, trade register and other source registers. Best authoritative key for IČO↔name↔legal form↔SK NACE resolution, which every downstream filing collector depends on. Licensed CC-BY 4.0.
candidates.access_status: open REST API, JSON; data refreshed nightly
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Build and refresh the SK financial-sector entity master table (SK NACE 64/65/66) from RPO; use as join key everywhere.

candidates.why_relevant: Catalogue listing the register datasets (RPO, RÚZ, central contract register, Obchodný vestník) with distributions and licences. Use it to discover new or renamed statutory datasets rather than hard-coding endpoints.

candidates.legal_status: third-party redistribution of open data; check terms before commercial use

negative_findings.description: Searched in Slovak for an open dataset or API exposing the Zbierka listín (commercial register document collection) itself. data.gov.sk and the MS SR open-data page point to register APIs (RPVS, ress-isu Swagger) but no evidence was found of a bulk, machine-readable feed of the scanned listiny.
negative_findings.result_summary: Document lists appear reachable per-entity via orsr.sk zbl.asp; full documents are requested via sluzby.orsr.sk, seemingly with eID and/or a court fee.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Corporate-action monitoring for non-listed SK banks/PSPs will need per-entity polling rather than a bulk feed, which raises collection cost and argues for prioritising a watchlist.

negative_findings.description: No official English-language interface was found for registeruz.sk or orsr.sk; English search results consistently redirect to commercial intermediaries (FinStat English services, Schmidt & Schmidt) or the EU BRIS node.
negative_findings.result_summary: English-only collection of the SK statutory channel is not viable; Slovak-language parsing of form templates and document labels is required.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Downstream extraction must handle Slovak field names (súvaha, výkaz ziskov a strát, poznámky, správa audítora); budget for a Slovak term mapping layer.

negative_findings.description: The domain registeructovnychzavierok.sk closely mimics the official registeruz.sk but is a private explainer site, not the statutory register.
negative_findings.result_summary: Recorded as low-credibility context source; official register is registeruz.sk (MF SR / DataCentrum).
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Prevents a collector or analyst from citing a non-authoritative site as the statutory source.

negative_findings.description: Several URLs recorded here (rpvs.gov.sk root, api.statistics.sk/rpo/v1/, sluzby.orsr.sk, the Slovensko.Digital S3 dump link) were referenced by search results or documentation pages but not individually fetched in this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: Recorded with URL + confidence only; no liveness claim made, per run rules.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The deterministic verification pass should prioritise these before a collector is built against them.

negative_findings.description: Searched in Slovak for a dedicated statutory filing channel specific to platobné inštitúcie / inštitúcie elektronických peňazí (separate from the generic RÚZ). None was found; NBS registers list authorisations but appear not to host the entities' own financial statements.
negative_findings.result_summary: Payment-institution accounts must be sourced from the generic RÚZ, keyed by IČO obtained from NBS lists.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Confirms the pointer→direct chain (NBS actor list → RPO IČO → RÚZ filings) as the correct architecture for this cell.

coverage_gaps.description: This cell yields the filing channel but not the entity list; no consolidated IČO watchlist of SK banks, foreign-bank branches, payment institutions, EMIs and payment agents was assembled in this pass.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build a watchlist by crawling the NBS PSD2 register and supervised-entity lists, resolving each name to an IČO via the RPO API, then feeding it to the RÚZ/ORSR collectors.

coverage_gaps.description: Branches of foreign banks (organizačné zložky) and cross-border PSD2 passported providers may have reduced or no standalone filing duty in the SK register, so their SK activity may be invisible in RÚZ.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Test coverage empirically for 3-5 known branches; where absent, fall back to parent-group reporting and NBS aggregate statistics (other cells).

coverage_gaps.description: RÚZ is documented as CC0 and RPO as CC BY 4.0, but the aggregator layers (Slovensko.Digital, FinStat, FOAF) carry their own terms whose commercial-use conditions were not established.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Review each aggregator's ToS/pricing before any commercial market-intel redistribution; default to the official CC0/CC-BY sources for anything published.

coverage_gaps.description: The richest narrative content (výročná správa, poznámky, správa audítora) arrives as PDF attachments; structure and OCR quality across banks were not sampled.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Sample annual-report attachments for 3-5 SK banks to assess whether text layers exist and whether IFRS note tables are extractable.

coverage_gaps.description: Filings before the 2014 reform were published in the Obchodný vestník / zbierka listín rather than RÚZ; the earliest reliable year of RÚZ coverage for financial-sector entities was not established.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Probe the RÚZ API for the earliest available statement years for a few banks; plan an Obchodný vestník archive route for pre-2014 series if long time series are required.

brief: Slovakia's statutory filing channel is unusually collector-friendly: the Register účtovných závierok (registeruz.sk, MF SR/DataCentrum) holds mandatory individual and consolidated statements, notes, auditor reports and annual reports for every accounting entity — banks, foreign-bank branches, payment institutions and fintech s.r.o. alike — and exposes them through a documented CC0 JSON Open API with incremental (zmenene-od) pulls. Around it sit complementary official layers: ORSR plus the Zbierka listín for corporate structure and capital events, the Obchodný vestník as a higher-frequency gazette of mergers, insolvencies and audited balance-sheet publications, RPVS for beneficial-ownership of anyone touching public money, and the RPO API as the IČO identity backbone. The main design consequence is that this cell is only as good as the actor list feeding it, so the NBS PSD2 and supervised-entity registers should be used as pointers to build an IČO watchlist before collection begins. Practical constraints: no official English interface (Slovak-language parsing is mandatory), no bulk feed of the zbierka listín documents themselves, and unstructured PDF annual reports as the main extraction cost; aggregators (Slovensko.Digital dumps, FinStat, FOAF) can shortcut ETL but carry their own licence terms.
